visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with dark hair sits at a restaurant table, wearing a black sweatshirt with a colorful floral graphic. He initially looks surprised, squinting his eyes before smiling and placing his hands under his chin in a playful blooming flower gesture. The background shows a dimly lit, high-end indoor venue with vertical wooden slats on the wall and a pink jacket draped over a chair. (2) A young woman with short dark hair, wearing a light blue button-up shirt, smiles radiantly directly at the camera. She makes quick, rhythmic motions with her clenched fists near her face. The scene is a spacious, modern restaurant with large windows overlooking a night city skyline. (3) A woman in a dark brown knit sweater with a textured pattern laughs heartily at the camera. She starts with her arms crossed defensively but quickly transitions into a two-handed peace sign. She is seated at a table set with ceramic plates and drinking glasses. (4) The camera pans across a group of three individuals seated at a long table. They all react to the lens by covering their faces with their hands in a shy, amused manner. The background features expansive windows with city lights visible through the glass. (5) In a different setting, a man in a green quilted jacket sits in a grey office chair against a plain white wall. He has his arms crossed and maintains a stern, stoic expression. He suddenly jerks his head upward in mock surprise, following an invisible object. (6) The same man in the office setting brings both hands to his cheeks, puffing them out and making an exaggeratedly cute expression. A gold watch is visible on his left wrist as he shifts his gaze toward the camera. (7) Back in the restaurant setting, multiple quick cuts show the group laughing and posing. The man in the black sweatshirt makes various funny faces and gestures, including a 'thinking' pose with his finger on his chin, while his friends watch and laugh in the background.
